author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Finally, I got my Signal connected to my Hermes agent. Then I don't know what can I use it for?

Write code? Cursor and Copilot cloud is better, it can even push back into GitHub.

Chat? ChatGPT is a lot more convenient

Automation? I have it all set up with GitHub workflow and Jenkins before AI exists

Can someone tell me what they use Claw or Hermes for? Why not just vibe code a script to do the same thing?
